description.value: You can sense the presence of magic auras as though you were always using a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Detect Magic] spell. This detects magic in your field of vision only. When you [[/act seek]], you gain the benefits of a 3rd-rank detect magic spell on things you see (in addition to the normal benefits of Seeking). You can turn this sense off and on with a free action at the start or the end of your turn.
